events.summary: Boros general Ferrous Rokiric erects ten stone titans, placing Zobor in the Center to defend it.
events.quote: the Boros general Ferrous Rokiric erected ten stone titans to stand watch over the city in its defense

events.summary: During the Decamillennial, quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla attack the Center on Savra's orders.
events.quote: the Center was attacked by quietmen and Golgari Raiders led by Ludmilla

events.summary: The Golgari create a sinkhole that topples and shatters Zobor, also destroying the Tower of Thismi and damaging the Centerfort and Rokiric Pavilion.
events.quote: The Golgari created a massive sinkhole beneath him, causing the titan to topple and shatter across the surface of the mountain.

events.summary: Savra's death and Jarad's succession end the Golgari attack and force a withdrawal.
events.quote: Only the death of Savra and the succession of leadership to her brother, Jarad vod Savo , ultimately brought the Golgari attack to an end

relations.quote: the Boros general Ferrous Rokiric erected ten stone titans

relations.note: Guildmaster at the time of the attack.
relations.quote: acting on the orders of their new guildmaster, Savra vod Savo
